lines.en: Short legs whirring; I keep close.

lines.zh: 我踩过的石子都成了粉。
lines.en: Every stone I tread on turns to powder.

lines.zh: 我是凿石者，被人驯熟了。
lines.en: I'm a stonecutter, tamed.
Stone dust coats my shell.
I walk close to my keeper.
I leave pale scratches as I go.
Four legs, hard at every joint.

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，声音很沉。
lines.en: A small shadow, a heavy sound.
Grit grinds in my mouth.
One small step, and I wait.
This armor is heavier than it looks.
I creep along the stone wall.
My steps tap like a chisel.
Gravel underfoot, and I walk on.

lines.zh: 我抬头看主人，又低头走。
lines.en: I glance up at my keeper, then down.
Small thing, no small strength.
I crouch like a whetstone.
An old crack in my shell.
I chew gravel slowly.
It's quiet; I listen.
A feeler tests the ground.
I wait for a beckoning hand.
The stone dust won't shake off.
I tilt my head at the sky.
The stone here is soft.
I shift into the shade.
Nothing to do, so I hone my claws.
My breathing rasps like sandpaper.
I settle a little lower.
I guard the doorway, still.
Are you my keeper?
I look up; my shell catches light.
I could bite through those boots.
I know your hands.
Not my keeper — then I'm wary.

lines.zh: 我抬着触须，等你的手势。
lines.en: I raise my feelers, waiting on your gesture.
Pet me? Mind the shell edge.
Small, but hard.

lines.zh: 你手垂下来，我甲才松开。
lines.en: Lower your hand and my shell unclenches.
I shuffle half a step toward you.
A low grating sound comes from me.
Don't put your hand on my back.
Eight points of shell on me.

lines.zh: 我在等一个熟悉的动作。
lines.en: I wait for a familiar gesture.
A fresh scratch, logged on my shell.
I pull my legs under my shell.
It hurts, but it isn't fatal.
I shrink back a little at a time.
Something seeps from a seam.
That made me angry.

lines.zh: 甲壳下的腿止不住地抖。
lines.en: The legs under my shell won't stop shaking.

lines.zh: 壳面崩了个小口，砂在漏。
lines.en: A chip in my shell, and grit leaks out.
Eight armor; I curl up tight.
Don't smash my shell.
That smells like ore.
I shuffle over, shell scraping.

lines.zh: 放地上，我用石头试试它。
lines.en: Set it down; I'll test it against stone.
Is this my reward?
I sniff close; I won't bite your hand.
One bite and it's gone.
I won't grab; I'll wait beside it.
I like things that taste of stone.
Step back and I come closer.
After eating I nuzzle your leg.
Too hard; I grind it down.
Another; I'm not full.
This taste reminds me of the mines.
Don't take it away; I'm nearly at it.
I'm low; easy to step on.
Bump me and you'll learn hard.
I step back to clear the way.
My shell scrapes your leg a bit.
Let's both stop.
I shake the grit off my back.
A pale scratch on the ground.
Don't push; my feet hold.
That tilted me.
My four feet grip again.

lines.zh: 我是被养熟的，不谈这个。
lines.en: I'm a kept pet; not this.
I rarely see my own kind.
Guarding my keeper is enough.
The rubble is too cold.
I just want to stay warm.
I don't understand such things.
I lie at my keeper's feet.
Even seaborn constructs get lonely.
No thank you.
I turn my back and sleep.
An ore chunk — I clamp it.
I rake it over with a foreleg.
This weight drags at my claw.
It fell; I pick it up.
It's wedged into a seam of my shell.
Useless, but I keep it.
I grind it before I can bite.
This one's mine; I've got it clamped.
A nice stone — I keep it.
Then I look back at my keeper.
Something's approaching.
I press my shell to the ground.
Not my keeper's steps.
My shell faces that way.
Marked; don't move.
I can hit from over twenty paces.
Grit grinds in my mouth.
The threat is ahead.
I give one warning first.
Don't retreat and I strike.
I face you, unmoving.
The grit in my shell is ready.
A short shuffle closer.
You circle; so do I.
At this range my grit can reach you.
I crouch and gather.
What I fire is hard.
Grit cutting the air.
No one should stand there.
One last shuffle.
I spit a spray of stone!
A shell butt sends you back.
Claws rake three lines.
Small, but I hit hard.
After the blow I tuck in.
I can reach from here.
Don't think I only dig.
Grit rings on your armor.

lines.zh: 我钳住你的护胫不撒口。
lines.en: I clamp your greave and won't let go.
This is my trade.
I crawl out of the rubble.
Sand still clings to my shell.
Anyone here? I seek my keeper.
Plenty of stone here.
I shake the grit off.
The stonecutter has arrived.
I lift my shell and sniff the air.
Hard ground — suits me.
First, find some shade.
My feet sink slightly in sand.
Fire heats my shell.
The landing numbs my legs.
Water fills my seams; I sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我整只箱子翻过去。
lines.en: The blast rolls my whole shell over.
An arrow shatters on my shell.

lines.zh: 有东西渗进甲壳的旧裂。
lines.en: Something seeps into the old crack in my shell.
Too hungry to grind stone.
Lightning hits the shell; all numb.
I fall, shell spinning.
